runs.name: score
runs.command: thinkthen score 'How urgent is this?' 'Routine.' 'Soon.' 'Immediate.' < outage.txt
runs.input: Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay.
runs.see: The outage scores 2.0, and 2 is Immediate on this scale.

runs.name: score-answer
runs.command: thinkthen score --details 'How urgent is this?' 'Routine.' 'Soon.' 'Immediate.' < outage.txt | jq '.answer.probabilities'
runs.input: Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay.
runs.see: The details put all of the weight on Immediate.

runs.name: score-between
runs.command: thinkthen score 'How urgent is this?' 'Routine.' 'Soon.' 'Immediate.' < flaky.txt
runs.input: A few customers say card payments fail now and then.
runs.see: The flaky payments score 0.78, close to Soon.

runs.name: score-between-answer
runs.command: thinkthen score --details 'How urgent is this?' 'Routine.' 'Soon.' 'Immediate.' < flaky.txt | jq -r '.answer.probabilities|tojson'
runs.input: A few customers say card payments fail now and then.
runs.see: Soon holds most of the weight, and the weighted average of the steps gives 0.78.
